data.content_html:
Last updated: 21 July 2026

NMIMS offers standard online and distance MBA pathways as well as an executive MBA for working professionals. The total amount depends on the program and payment plan, so this guide compares the published tuition, instalment choices and additional charges in one place.

NMIMS Online and Distance MBA Fees

The standard two-year MBA costs ₹1,96,000 with a one-time payment. The annual plan totals ₹2,10,000, while four semester payments total ₹2,20,000.

Payment planPayment amountTotal two-year cost
One-time payment₹1,96,000 once₹1,96,000
Annual plan₹1,05,000 per year₹2,10,000
Semester plan₹55,000 per semester₹2,20,000
Monthly EMIFrom approximately ₹8,750Depends on lender and tenure

NMIMS MBA Fees by Specialization

The listed MBA specializations follow the same standard program fee. Choosing a specialization does not change the one-time tuition shown below.

NMIMS Executive MBA Fees

The two-year NMIMS Online Executive MBA (MBA WX) costs ₹4,00,000 with a one-time payment. Its annual plan totals ₹4,50,000, and the available monthly plan totals ₹4,27,500 across 15 payments.

Executive MBA payment planPayment amountTotal two-year cost

Annual plan₹2,50,000 in year one and ₹2,00,000 in year two₹4,50,000
Monthly plan₹28,500 for 15 months₹4,27,500

Additional Charges

  • Admission processing fee: ₹1,200
  • Initial amount at registration: ₹10,000, adjusted against program fees
  • Examination fee: ₹800 per subject per attempt
  • Project fee: ₹800 per attempt

EMI, Scholarships and Payment Planning

EMI availability, tenure and final interest depend on the selected lender. The standard MBA source material lists monthly payments from approximately ₹8,750. Eligible armed forces, defence and paramilitary personnel and their immediate families may qualify for the stated 20% concession; applicants should confirm current terms before paying.

Which Payment Plan Costs the Least?

The one-time plan has the lowest listed tuition for both the standard MBA and Executive MBA. Annual, semester and EMI plans reduce the amount due upfront but increase the total paid or may add lender-specific costs. Always verify the current fee sheet and refund terms before enrollment.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for the NMIMS Online MBA?
faqs.answer: The listed two-year fee is ₹1,96,000 with a one-time payment, ₹2,10,000 with annual payments, or ₹2,20,000 with semester payments.

faqs.question: Does NMIMS offer EMI for online MBA fees?
faqs.answer: Yes. The standard MBA material lists EMI from approximately ₹8,750 per month, subject to the lender, tenure and current financing terms.

faqs.question: Do NMIMS MBA fees change by specialization?
faqs.answer: The listed standard MBA specializations share the same tuition structure, with a ₹1,96,000 one-time payment or ₹2,20,000 semester-plan total.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for the NMIMS Executive MBA?
faqs.answer: The two-year Executive MBA costs ₹4,00,000 with a one-time payment. The annual plan totals ₹4,50,000 and the listed monthly plan totals ₹4,27,500.

faqs.question: Are exam and admission charges included in the tuition?
faqs.answer: Additional listed charges include a ₹1,200 admission processing fee, ₹800 per subject per exam attempt and ₹800 per project attempt.
